markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Colour Stories
summary: Three colour stories for SS27 kidswear: Pool Brights, Seaside Calm and Red and Navy.

sections.heading: Pool Brights
sections.body: Aqua, lemon, coral and grass green for swim, play and summer camp. It reflects Pitti Bimbo's pool theme and colourful summer edition<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Seaside Calm
sections.body: Sand, white, soft navy, vintage pink and pastel green for basics, baby and nightwear. It follows Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" palette<sup>[2]</sup> and Future Snoops' Lull<sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Red and Navy
sections.body: Red, navy and white for stripes, sailor pieces and denim, from Playtime Paris<sup>[4]</sup>.

design_implications:
- One delivery or capsule per story.
- Seaside Calm mixes with both other stories.
commercial_implications: - Seaside Calm and Red and Navy carry volume; Pool Brights peaks before holidays.
